title: What Mantle Drilling Projects Is
definition: Mantle Drilling Projects: drilling toward the mantle for limitless heat.
description:
Mantle Drilling Projects: drilling toward the mantle for limitless heat. This is Future Energy Systems at its most ambitious — ultra-deep rigs research, drill logistics engineering and material science operations converging on a single goal: making drill hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Energy Systems will decide borehole stability outcomes this century. Mantle Drilling Projects is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working drill hulls, the larger ultra-deep rigs vision stalls, and with it, the drill logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Mantle Drilling Projects in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Mantle Drilling Projects
definition: Today's documented research behind Mantle Drilling Projects.
description:
The road to Mantle Drilling Projects is already being paved. The International Energy Agency tracks 500+ GW of annual solar additions in its net-zero scenarios. The US National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition (net energy gain) in December 2022.

Perovskite solar cells have passed 33% tandem efficiency in laboratory records. Together these programs form the ultra-deep rigs foundation that Mantle Drilling Projects will build on — the drill logistics results, the material science methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as drill logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: 2032 — First commercial drill hulls plant sells ultra-deep rigs power t
definition: 2032 milestone on the Mantle Drilling Projects roadmap.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed ultra-deep rigs demonstrations, drill logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting material science uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Mantle Drilling Projects
definition: Estimates Mantle Drilling Projects readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mantle Drilling Projects components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a drill hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Mantle Drilling Projects Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mantle Drilling Projects: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mantle Drilling Projects — drilling toward the mantle for limitless heat.

Phase 1 — Prove (ultra-deep rigs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (drill logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (material science): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (borehole stability): drill hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and crust-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
